chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Salama ibn al-Khattab, from Ibrahim ibn Uqba, from Salih ibn Ali ibn Atiyya, from a man he mentioned, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) passed by a group of the Ansar while they were plowing, so he said to them: 'Plow, for the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Allah causes growth by the wind as He causes growth by the rain.' He said: 'So they plowed, and their crops grew abundantly.'

key_terms.الْأَنْصَارِ: The Helpers, referring to the early supporters of Islam in Medina

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about the role of wind in crop growth?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) validates the natural efficacy of agricultural labor by citing the Prophet’s teaching that wind acts as a divine agent of growth alongside rain, thereby affirming the permissibility and virtue of seeking sustenance through work. This narration underscores the Shia theological balance between tawakkul (trust in God) and taking practical means (asbab), illustrating that natural phenomena are direct manifestations of divine will.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Salma Bin Al Khattab, from Ibrahim Bin Uqba, from Salih Bin Ali Bin Atiyya, from a man who mentioned it, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said:

‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> passed by a people from the Helpers and they were farming, so he<sup>asws</sup> said to them: ‘Keep farming, for Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would Cause it to grow by the wind as He<sup>azwj</sup> Causes it to grow by the rain’. He (the narrator) said, ‘They farmed, and their cultivation was better’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Salmah ibn al-Khattab from Ibrahim ibn ‘Uqbah from Salih ibn Ali ibn ‘Atiyyah from a whom he has mentioned who has said the following: “Abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, once passed by a people of al-Ansar who were farming and he (the Imam) said to them, ‘Continue farming; the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said, “Allah causes it to grow by wind as He does so by water.’” They farmed and their farm turned out good.”
